blocks.text: This Surface Pro is a Copilot+ PC with an ARM-based Snapdragon processor. Daily tasks, Microsoft 365, web browsing, video calls, and streaming run smoothly. Many traditional x86 apps also work through Windows emulation. However, some legacy or driver-dependent software, certain games, and device utilities may require an ARM64 version or may not be available yet. Please check app compatibility with the publisher before purchase.

The computer is professionally upgraded and customized. The manufacturer box will be opened by our professional engineers for customizing and testing. Factory defects and blemishes are significantly reduced by our in-depth inspection and testing. We offer a 12-month warranty, please feel free to contact us if you need any support from our team.

Experience unparalleled productivity in ultra-portable laptop designs, with battery life that lasts for days. . The integrated Qualcomm Adreno GPU delivers graphics-intensive presentations and entertainment.

[AI-enhanced Surface Studio Camera] The ultra-wide front facing camera paired with AI-powered Studio effects like automatic framing keeps you, or the whole family in focus, even as you move around your space.
[All day battery life] With up to 14 hours of battery life, Surface Pro can keep up with whatever you need to do, wherever you need to do it, all day long.
